verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an official Mail MCP server connecting Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants directly to inbox/calendar, enabling reading, summarizing, drafting, and sending emails via prompts, with explicit send-approval controls for safety. This is corroborated by a dedicated feature page and blog post, plus a probe confirming the MCP server's existence, though independent hands-on verification of the MCP flow itself is absent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of the MCP connection actually working end-to-end, and detail on triage/read capabilities specifically via the MCP interface beyond marketing copy.
